stem: The immediate process problem has been corrected. Why should the original deviation record remain unchanged?
choices: It should not; correcting the process means the record should be rewritten
The original event is part of the evidence trail; corrections and follow-up should be appended with who/when rather than erasing what occurred
Only paper records need an audit trail
Old records are useful only for payroll
rationale: Evidence integrity requires preserving the original event and documenting subsequent correction separately. Rewriting history prevents reliable investigation and recurrence analysis.
